User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the StudyBuddy application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

creationDate.description: The date and time the user was created.

Study.title: Study
Study.description: Represents a single study activity conducted by a user, such as a tutor session, a quiz, or a set of flashcards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the study entity.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this study item.

topic.description: The main topic of the study session (e.g., 'Photosynthesis', 'World War II').

createdAt.description: The server-side timestamp when the study item was created.

messages.description: For 'tutor' type: an array of conversation messages.

notes.description: For 'summaries' type: the original notes that were summarized.

flashcards.description: For 'flashcards' type: an array of flashcard objects.

quiz.description: For 'quizzes' type: an array of quiz question objects.

definition.description: Stores all user-generated study materials, including tutor conversations, summaries, flashcards, and quizzes. Access is strictly limited to the user who owns the document, enforced by security rules checking the 'userId' field.

params.name: studyId
params.description: The unique identifier of the study document.

definition.description: Stores public user profile information. Each document is keyed by the user's UID. Users can create and update their own profile, but cannot delete it or modify others' profiles.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's unique ID (UID) from Firebase Authentication.

firestore.reasoning: A 'studies' collection stores all user-generated content, secured by a 'userId' field. A separate 'users' collection stores public profile data, keyed by UID, which allows for user-specific data to be managed separately from their private study materials. This separation enhances security and data organization.
